title: 第99章 撕碎伪装，上海不收洋垃圾

第99章 撕碎伪装，上海不收洋垃圾-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

下午两点。

浦东国际机场。

十二辆黑色奔驰S级轿车在航站楼外一字排开。

引导车辆打着双闪，排场极大。

方志远站在最前面，理了理领带。

孙乾站在他身旁，手里捏着一份行程单。

出站口走出一群人。

走在最中间的是个五十多岁的中年男人，身材矮壮，穿着深蓝色条纹西装，眼神带着审视。

太平洋桥基金亚太区合伙人，渡边一郎。

方志远迎上去，伸出双手。

“渡边先生，一路辛苦。上海市府那边已经安排了接风晚宴，许副市长亲自出席。”

渡边一郎随手握了一下，很快收回手。

“方总，我只关心张江的场地和政策。住友的封测技术，不是什么地方都有资格承接的。”

“您放心。”

方志远侧过身引路。

“今晚的晚宴，就是为了解决这个问题。张江那几块地，今天之后，必须给太平洋桥腾出来。”

孙乾站在后面，看着车队驶离，冷笑一声。

林川再能打，也就是个地头蛇。

外资、先进技术、市府领导，这三座大山压下来，九州创投只能粉身碎骨。

傍晚六点。

虹桥别墅。

林川站在落地镜前。

深灰色高定西装，剪裁极简，没有多余装饰。

他扣上袖扣，转身走向门外。

院子里停着一辆黑色劳斯莱斯幻影。

车窗降下，顾清烟坐在后座。

她今天穿了一袭黑色丝绒晚礼服，长发盘起，露出修长的脖颈。

没有繁复珠宝，只戴了一对珍珠耳坠。

清冷，且极具压迫感。

林川拉开车门坐进去。

“车不错。”

林川看了一眼内饰。

“顾氏接待贵宾的专用车。”

顾清烟递过一份文件。

“渡边一郎，太平洋桥亚太区负责人。他这次带来的技术授权，主要集中在半导体后道封测。市里很重视。”

林川没接文件。

“不用看。”

林川靠在椅背上。

“假的真不了。”

顾清烟侧头看他。

她看不透林川的底气从哪里来。

但她见过林川出手。

这个人从不把希望押在运气上。

晚上七点。

外滩和平饭店，顶层宴会厅。

水晶吊灯将大厅照得通明。

上海商界、政界的核心人物到了大半。

许副市长坐在主桌，正和渡边一郎交谈。

方志远陪坐一旁，满面红光。

宴会厅大门推开。

林川和顾清烟并肩走入。

没有通报，没有寒暄。

两人一出现，大厅里的声音明显低了下去。

林川身姿挺拔，眼神沉静。

顾清烟走在他身侧。

两人站在一起，硬生生把满场喧嚣压了下去。

许副市长抬头，看到林川，微微点头。

方志远脸色一沉。

他没想到顾清烟会亲自给林川做女伴。

顾家的分量，在上海不容小觑。

2 p.m.

Pudong International Airport.

Twelve black Mercedes-Benz S-Class cars were lined up outside the terminal.

The guided vehicle was flashing double-flashes, which was a great spectacle.

Fang Zhiyuan stood at the front and straightened his tie.

Sun Qian stood beside him, holding an itinerary in his hand.

A group of people walked out of the station.

Walking in the middle was a middle-aged man in his fifties, short and stocky, wearing a dark blue striped suit, with scrutinizing eyes.

Ichiro Watanabe, partner of Pacific Bridge Fund Asia Pacific.

Fang Zhiyuan stepped forward and stretched out his hands.

"Mr. Watanabe, it's been a hard journey. The Shanghai Municipal Government has arranged a reception dinner, and Vice Mayor Xu will attend in person."

Ichiro Watanabe shook his hand casually and quickly withdrew his hand.

"Mr. Fang, I only care about Zhangjiang's venue and policies. Not everyone is qualified to undertake Sumitomo's packaging and testing technology."

"Don't worry."

Fang Zhiyuan turned sideways to lead the way.

"Tonight's dinner is to solve this problem. The land in Zhangjiang must be vacated for the Pacific Bridge after today."

Sun Qian stood behind, watching the motorcade drive away, and sneered.

No matter how good Lin Chuan is, he is just a local snake.

Foreign investment, advanced technology, and city government leaders, if these three mountains come down, Jiuzhou Venture Capital can only be shattered into pieces.

Six o'clock in the evening.

Hongqiao Villa.

Lin Chuan stood in front of the floor-length mirror.

A dark gray haute couture suit with minimalist tailoring and no extra decoration.

He buttoned his cufflinks and turned to walk out the door.

Parked in the yard was a black Rolls-Royce Phantom.

The window was lowered and Gu Qingyan sat in the back seat.

She wore a black velvet evening dress today, with her long hair tied up, revealing her slender neck.

There was no complicated jewelry, just a pair of pearl earrings.

It's cold and very oppressive.

Lin Chuan opened the car door and got in.

"The car is nice."

Lin Chuan took a look at the interior.

"Gu's special car for receiving distinguished guests."

Gu Qingyan handed over a document.

"Ichiro Watanabe, head of Pacific Bridge Asia Pacific. The technology authorization he brought this time is mainly focused on semiconductor back-end packaging and testing. The city attaches great importance to it."

Lin Chuan did not receive the document.

"No need to look."

Lin Chuan leaned back on the chair.

"Fake things can't be true."

Gu Qingyan looked sideways at him.

She couldn't see where Lin Chuan's confidence came from.

But she had seen Lin Chuan take action.

This man never puts his hopes on luck.

7 p.m.

Bund Peace Hotel, top floor banquet hall.

Crystal chandeliers illuminate the hall.

Most of the core figures in Shanghai's business and political circles have arrived.

Vice Mayor Xu was sitting at the main table, talking with Ichiro Watanabe.

Fang Zhiyuan sat beside him, his face glowing red.

The banquet hall door opened.

Lin Chuan and Gu Qingyan walked in side by side.

No briefings, no pleasantries.

As soon as the two people appeared, the voices in the hall became noticeably lower.

Lin Chuan's posture was upright and his eyes were calm.

Gu Qingyan walked beside him.

The two stood together and suppressed the din of the whole place.

Vice Mayor Xu looked up, saw Lin Chuan, and nodded slightly.

Fang Zhiyuan's face darkened.

He didn't expect that Gu Qingyan would personally be Lin Chuan's female companion.

The importance of the Gu family cannot be underestimated in Shanghai.
